## Definition of done
- [ ] Preview loads with real content or clearly labelled fixture
- [ ] Before/after at desktop 1440 and mobile 390, mid/final screen
- [ ] Lazy images and overlays checked after actual scroll
- [ ] Keyboard/focus/contrast/reduced-motion/empty states
- [ ] Functional/data/SEO invariant checks
- [ ] Independent visual review APPROVE
- [ ] PR merged into approved integration branch and preview smoke verified
- [ ] Worktree safely retained or archived, Issue status updated
